devsecops.reason: Delivery controls not explicitly selected remain shared platform behavior or future application decisions.

infrastructure.reason: Podinfo consumes an existing target and does not own infrastructure provisioning or cloud execution.

kubernetes.reason: The application requires selected workload controls; cluster lifecycle and optional workload features remain platform-owned.

observability.reason: Selected release signals are required; broader telemetry and SRE capabilities remain shared or service-criticality dependent.

governance.reason: Selected identity and secret controls are required; other governance controls depend on data, risk and regulatory scope.

linux.reason: Podinfo is documented as a Kubernetes workload and does not own a VM or native operating-system service.

database.reason: The documented Podinfo slice is stateless and has no application database or persistence contract.

resilience.reason: Selected ownership, readiness and expiry controls are required; broader continuity practices depend on later service criticality.

data.reason: Podinfo does not produce or consume provider, payer or analytical business data in the documented scope.

network.reason: Selected DNS, TLS and access-path controls are required; network lifecycle capabilities remain platform-owned.

healthcare-ai.reason: Podinfo contains no healthcare AI behavior, clinical knowledge workflow or model-assisted decision.

mlops.reason: Podinfo has no model artifact, serving path, evaluation, monitoring or model rollback responsibility.
